title: The Bitcoin Bottom Is NOT In (Elliott Wave)
speaker: BitcoinHyper host

macro_themes.view: The bounce since Feb 2026 is a three-wave B wave (expanded flat); a C wave down should finish the bear market around Jan 18 2027.

calls.condition: A break and acceptance below ~77k (value area high / weekly level) confirms the C wave; if it rallies to 95-97k without bearish divergences, a bullish count comes into play
calls.reason: Wave B hit the 0.5 retrace / 1.236 extension near 87k with bearish divergences on the RSI, MACD and AO (1D/2D/3D); wave C = A projects 55k then 41.5k, with the bottom timed for ~Jan 18 2027.
calls.quote: This entire Bitcoin bounce looks like just three waves. And if I'm right on this one, lower is next.

notes: Host name not given. Short term is mixed: it could still push to 95-97k (max ~100k) before the drop. Long-term bias is bearish to a ~40-41.5k bottom around Jan 2027, then a new bull market is expected.
